component.name: Human Time System
component.summary: An infinite, cyclical calendar designed for deep time

description.p: The Storcke Human Time System (HTS) is a revolutionary, epoch-based calendar architecture built to outlast human civilization. Starting at A0 (40,000 years pre-2023), it utilizes 50,000-year Epochs represented by the Latin alphabet, eliminating traditional calendar bugs and timezone complexities through pure integer math.

ul.li: Drop-in integration for standard Linux time commands via the hts-time CLI.
A comprehensive GUI dashboard for converters, timezones, and system status.
Deep-time integer math ideal for gaming, simulations, and long-term archival.
